faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started — from coaching structure to progress, nutrition, and support.

items.question: Do I need gym experience to start?
items.answer: No. The coaching is built around your current level, not an ideal starting point. Whether you're completely new or returning after a long break, everything is structured so you can start confidently and progress at a pace that fits you.

items.question: Is nutrition coaching included?
items.answer: Yes. Nutrition is part of the process, not an afterthought. The goal is to create a simple, realistic structure you can actually follow — based on your lifestyle, schedule, food preferences, and overall goal.

items.question: Can I work with you from anywhere?
items.answer: Yes. The coaching is designed to work remotely, so you can follow the plan from anywhere as long as you have a way to train consistently and stay in communication. Everything is built to be flexible, structured, and easy to follow online.

items.question: When should I expect to see progress?
items.answer: That depends on your starting point, consistency, and goal — but most clients notice meaningful progress within the first few weeks when they follow the structure consistently. The focus is not just fast results, but results you can actually maintain.

items.question: What if I have injuries or limitations?
items.answer: That is taken into account from the start. Exercises, volume, intensity, and progression can all be adjusted based on your limitations, training history, and recovery capacity. The goal is to train intelligently, not force a plan that doesn't fit your body.

items.question: How often will we review progress?
items.answer: Progress is reviewed consistently, not randomly. Depending on your plan, goals, and phase, adjustments are made based on performance, recovery, adherence, and real-life feedback — so the process keeps moving forward without guesswork.

items.question: Can we adjust the plan later?
items.answer: Absolutely. The plan is meant to evolve with you. As your schedule, recovery, performance, or goals change, the structure can be refined so it continues to stay effective, realistic, and aligned with your lifestyle.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer: That depends on the type of coaching and your setup. In most cases, you only need a realistic training environment, consistency, and a willingness to follow structure. If you're training at a gym, at home, or with limited equipment, the plan can be adapted accordingly.
